en.headline: Hong Kong women take Asian Games silver in 4x100m freestyle relay
en.dek: Siobhan Haughey and teammates clock a Hong Kong record 3:36.59 for the city’s second medal of the Nagoya Games, finishing behind China.
body: Hong Kong’s women’s 4x100m freestyle relay team won silver at the Asian Games in Nagoya on Sunday, delivering the city’s second medal of the Games after Grace Lau’s karate silver earlier in the day.

The quartet of Gilaine Ma, Olympic silver medallist Siobhan Haughey, Li Sum-yiu and Natalie Kan finished in 3 minutes 36.59 seconds, a new Hong Kong record. China took gold in a Games record 3:33.10, with Japan third in 3:39.09.
Haughey swam the second leg and lifted the team from fourth into silver medal position. The previous Hong Kong best of 3:39.10 was set when the team won bronze at the Hangzhou Games.
In the men’s events, Hayden Kwan twice broke the Hong Kong 100m backstroke record, first in the heats and then again in the final where he finished seventh in 55.11 seconds.

zh.headline: 港隊女子4x100米自由泳接力摘銀 亞運第二面獎牌
zh.dek: 何詩蓓與隊友以3分36秒59刷新香港紀錄，僅次於中國隊，為港隊再添一銀。
body: 香港女子4x100米自由泳接力隊周日在名古屋亞運會奪得銀牌，繼劉慕裳空手道銀牌後，為港隊再添一獎牌。
馬希文、奧運銀牌得主何詩蓓、李心瑤及簡綽桐以3分36秒59完成賽事，刷新香港紀錄。中國隊以3分33秒10破會紀錄奪金，日本隊3分39秒09獲銅。
何詩蓓游第二棒，將港隊由第四提升至銀牌位置。港隊上屆杭州亞運以3分39秒10奪銅，今次成績大幅提升。
男子項目方面，關浩揚兩度刷新香港100米背泳紀錄，決賽以55秒11列第七。
